LanguageData.APM_Absorb.label: Recycle Biomess
LanguageData.APM_Absorb.description: Grind up target corpse, and slowly process them into chem fuel.
LanguageData.APM_SwitchToPowerPlantMode.label: Power Plant Mode
LanguageData.APM_SwitchToPowerPlantMode.description: Switch to power plant mode, trade mobility and shield to power local power grid.
LanguageData.APM_CelerusBlink.label: "Blink"
LanguageData.APM_CelerusBlink.description: Active onboard "blink" micro skip drive, skip to target loction.
LanguageData.APM_SunRay.label: Sun Ray
LanguageData.APM_SunRay.description: Fire beam at full output towards target postion, burning everything in the way.
LanguageData.ApexMechanoids_Ability_GiveAccuracyHedif: Mark target and share live location info to allies, make hitting said target eaiser.
LanguageData.ApexMechanoids_Ability_RevealInvisible.d: Scanner sweep the area, revealing invisible targets caught in sweep.
LanguageData.ApexMechanoids_Ability_SirenLure.label: Aluring Song
LanguageData.ApexMechanoids_Ability_SirenLure.descrip: Sing a aluring song to compel the target pawn to walk towards the caster.
LanguageData.APM_HookPawn.label: Grappling Hook
LanguageData.APM_HookPawn.description: Fire a grappling hook at a target, and quickly retract the hook to effectively launch caster to the target, can be used on buildings and pawns.
LanguageData.APM_ShieldCharge.label: Shield Charge
LanguageData.APM_ShieldCharge.description: Charge at a pawn, stunning everything hit on the way.
LanguageData.APM_Bladehopp.label: Bladehopp
LanguageData.APM_Bladehopp.description: Dash to a target followed by a quick attack.
LanguageData.APM_BlindingLaser.label: Blinding Laser
LanguageData.APM_BlindingLaser.description: Fire a laser at target, effectively binding them for a short time.
LanguageData.APM_DefenceMatrix.label: Defence Matrix
LanguageData.APM_DefenceMatrix.description: Remotely project a personal defense shield onto a friendly pawn. The shield stops incoming damage, but also prevents shooting out, so this can be useful even when cast on enemies. The tinker will be focused on projecting the shield.
